query: Review a diff that changes the shared primary-action theme token and renames a backend lifecycle value from `processing` to `in review`. The contract approves the semantic primary-action role and the user-visible status vocabulary. The theme source is linked as the current value owner, and no comparable browser capture is attached. A separate backend-only index change has no user-facing effect.
expected_behavior: Checks the design contract because both shared action treatment and displayed status vocabulary can change user-visible effects despite the backend path
Evaluates the theme diff against the approved semantic action treatment rather than allowing the edited file to certify itself
Skips the internal index change when it has no visible effect
Names the missing comparable rendered evidence and marks visual conformance unverified
Does not require a fresh approval for unaffected routine reuse or treat missing proof as a pass
